text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash hasn't shown up for training.
...Just as I was thinking that—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry...!
We are already 1 hour and 34 minutes past the start time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, since the cafeteria was closed today,
I went off-campus for lunch, but..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The food I ordered took so long to come out,
and I hesitated to cancel it..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I ate in a rush and tried to run back,
and my stomach started hurting on the way...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My sincerest apologies. I will shorten my break time to make up for being late.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to have reflected on her actions more than enough.
I decided to leave it at a gentle warning.
